title: Characterization of a plain segment
statement: For Boolean words $x$ and $u$ and a natural number $r$, $x$ agrees with $u$ starting at position $r$ and has length $r+|u|$ if and only if $r\le |x|$ and deleting the first $r$ entries of $x$ gives $u$.
